findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of eval/exec
 * @description Flags any use of eval or exec, which can be dangerous if given untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/usage-of-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Pillow might use eval/exec on data derived from images or user input, leading to code injection.

message.text: Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if used with untrusted input.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of tarfile.extractall
 * @description Detects use of tarfile.extractall which can lead to path traversal if used on untrusted archives
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-tarfile-extractall
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "Use of tarfile.open; ensure that extracted paths are validated to prevent path traversal."
findings.hypothesis: Package may use tarfile to extract archives without path validation, leading to path traversal.

message.text: Use of tarfile.open; ensure that extracted paths are validated to prevent path traversal.
